description: This bar chart illustrates the number of factual errors across four different question answering (QA) datasets: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC, for two different QA approaches: NoR QA and OneR QA. The horizontal axis displays the QA dataset names in the order HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The vertical axis, labeled “Factual Errors,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 5. Four bars are present for each dataset, representing the factual errors for NoR QA (orange), OneR QA (red), and IRCoT QA (blue). For HotpotQA, the NoR QA bar reaches a value of 15, the OneR QA bar reaches 10, and there is no bar for IRCoT QA. For 2WikiMQA, the NoR QA bar reaches 29, the OneR QA bar reaches 23, and the IRCoT QA bar reaches 14. For MuSiQue, the NoR QA bar reaches 28, the OneR QA bar reaches 23, and the IRCoT QA bar reaches 15. Finally, for IIRC, the NoR QA bar reaches 27, the OneR QA bar reaches 23, and the IRCoT QA bar reaches 11. The bars are grouped by dataset, with each group containing one bar for each QA approach. No bars are visually emphasized.
